name: lora-full-native-40000-lr5e-5
description: Native 40000-step text SFT; PEFT LoRA on the complete text/understanding decoder path (all 28 layers, attention and MLP projections outside the generation-only MoT experts), rank 32, alpha 64, dropout 0.05. One launch from step 0 over 2 epochs (20000 steps/epoch) with a single cosine schedule from the 200-step warm-up to step 40000.
checkpoint_selection: Retained points are pinned by step (keep_checkpoint_steps) plus the trailing best-CE points (keep_best_ce_steps). model.pt is written after merge_and_unload so it stays a plain text-model state_dict; the pinned step_*.pt files stay in raw LoRA form because they are resume-capable.
